items.title: La-Z-Boy Incorporated Reports Solid Second Quarter Results; Strong Sales Growth In Both Retail And Core North America La-Z-Boy Wholesale Businesses
items.summary: La-Z-Boy Incorporated (NYSE: LZB), a global leader in the retail and manufacture of residential furniture, today reported second quarter results for the period ended October 24, 2026. For the quarter, sales totaled $526 million, growing 1% against the prior year comparable period, or 4% excluding the impact of the wholesale casegoods divestiture completed in May, with strong growth in both Retail and core North America La-Z-Boy wholesale sales. Operating margin was 4.1% for the quarter on a GAAP
